content.value: A slightly stretched string of length l with fixed end points $x = 0$ and $x = l$ is initially at rest in its equilibrium position. If it starts vibrating by. giving to each of its points with a velocity $\lambda _ { x } ( l - x )$ , find the displacement $y ( x , t )$ of the string at any distance x at any time $t > 0 .$
